description: This PHP class file defines the BillingConductorClient class for interacting with the AWS Billing Conductor service. It extends the AwsClient class and contains method annotations for various operations related to billing, such as associating accounts, creating billing groups, listing billing reports, and updating billing configurations. The file serves as a client stub used to invoke AWS Billing Conductor service API calls.
